A must stop for a taste of real Mexico
Sep 2026 • Family
The restaurant is located in a narrow alley off of the main beach section. The setting is very friendly with clean tables and friendly service. The fish tacos, shrimp tacos, and corn chips were especially good. The tamale was wrapped in banana leaf which was different but did not distract from a very nice masa texture. We also enjoyed a pleasant conversation with the owner who gave us a brief history of the restaurant. A definite must stop for a real taste of Mexican food.

Best Mexican Restaurants in Vietnam
Jan 2026 • Couples
Mexican Choice is without a doubt the best Mexican restaurant in Vietnam.

The tortillas are 100% Mexican corn, very rare outside Mexico, and you can tell from the first bite. The food is authentic, faithful to the flavors, techniques and quality of Mexican cuisine.

In addition, the hosts are friendly, attentive and genuinely hospitable, which makes the experience even better.

The totopos and martajada sauce are delicious and give you complimentary, something that only Mexicans and Koreans value.

Great option for Mexican food!
Nov 2022 • Solo
Sister restaurant is in Hanoi. Ingredients are brought in fresh from Mexico.

First impressions are always important and the fact that they offered a bowl of chips with salsa, I’m already in love.

12 tacos to choose from with a number of other dishes also on the menu makes for a very decent offering.

Ordered three tacos, Barbacoa De Res, Tinga and Pastor. All were on point. The Tinga was a bit wet and destroyed the tortilla before I could eat it all but no worries.

Margaritas are stiff and that’s always a good sign.

Would I come back? Possibly. I would want to widen my range of Mexican food experience and go beyond the staple tacos. Specials, new menu items, yes! I would come back for that.
